subject: Proposed MAP & Contract Sequence for NovaHealth POC
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novahealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@novahealth.com>
Date: 2025-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC procurement sequence & contract asks

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement and legal asked me to capture the sequencing so we can share with our finance and security teams. High level asks:

- We need a mutual action plan (MAP) showing milestones for evaluation, success criteria, and a target close date.
- Legal wants clarity on the MSA/DPA signing order and whether the order form can be countersigned after the POC.
- Security asked for SOC2 evidence and encryption/KMS details before environment access.

Can you send a proposed MAP + proposed contract sequencing? Targeting a decision by the end of October if possible.

Samantha
Samantha Cole
Procurement Lead, NovaHealth
Samantha.Cole@novahealth.com
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novahealth.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@novahealth.com>, ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-09-12T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC procurement sequence & contract asks

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clear list. I attached a first-draft MAP (redwood_map_v1.pdf) and a recommended contract sequencing. Executive summary below:

1) MAP: 3-week evaluation window (technical validation week 1, workload run-through week 2, holdout tests & SLO verification week 3). Acceptance gated on 3 key prompts: latency under 350ms P95, median token cost under agreed budget, and accuracy on provided eval set >= baseline.

2) Contract sequencing (recommended):
- Sign MSA + DPA in parallel (legal alignment) — these should be fully executed before production data is provided.
- Execute order form for the POC environment as a pilot order form (short-term, limited spend) to allow access and billing to start. The order form can be amended/expanded after the POC.

Practical note: if your legal needs more time, we can provision a time-limited evaluation account under an interim NDA + narrower DPA addendum. That keeps momentum while legal finishes redlines.

Looping in Ava Chen from Legal to confirm any must-haves we should anticipate on the MSA/DPA side.

Next steps: if that sequencing works, I can convert the MAP to a mutual action view with owner/assignee columns and share a DocuSign bundle for MSA+DPA initial review.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novahealth.com>, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-09-18T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC procurement sequence & contract asks

Hi Samantha, Ben —

Thanks for the context. A few legal points to note:

- Redwood prefers MSA + DPA executed prior to transfer of any sensitive production data. For a POC using synthetic or anonymized data, we can accept a limited scope specified in the order form and a tech-access addendum.
- Order form for the POC should be time-boxed (30 days) and reference the MSA by version number; this lets the order form be lightweight while preserving contractual linkage for billing and liability.
- We'll provide our standard SOC2 Type II report (attached) and a KMS integration note. If NovaHealth requires HSM-level attestations, we may need a short follow-up for the Private deployment option.

I've attached a redline starter for the MSA (redwood_msa_redlines_v1.docx). Laura — could you confirm whether the POC order form template we use for enterprise trials suffices or if we should create a customized POC order form for NovaHealth?

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@novahealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novahealth.com>
Date: 2025-09-24T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC procurement sequence & contract asks

Ava —

Thanks for the quick response and the SOC2 report. A couple of clarifying items from our infosec:

- For the POC we will only use de-identified datasets. If the MSA/DPA timeline requires execution before access, that's fine — we'll prioritize those reviews.
- Regarding KMS: we need to confirm whether Redwood can support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for logs and model artifacts. If not immediately available, indicate a roadmap/timeline.

Procurement note for Ben: Can you confirm approximate turnaround times from your side for: 1) MSA redline review round (ours), 2) DPA comment turnaround, and 3) DocuSign execution after final forms? We're trying to map an internal approval window that ends 2025-10-30.

Mark
IT Procurement, NovaHealth
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novahealth.com>, Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@novahealth.com>
Cc: ava_chen@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-10-01T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC procurement sequence & contract asks

Hi Samantha / Mark —

Quick status and timeline to align with NovaHealth's 2025-10-30 decision target: 

1) Turnarounds: 
- MSA redline review: we aim for 3 business days per round for standard enterprise redlines (internal legal + your redlines).
- DPA comments: 2 business days typical, unless there are bespoke data processing clauses.
- DocuSign execution after final agreement: 1 business day for both parties once signatories are aligned.

2) KMS: we support customer-managed keys in Private deployments today; for Hosted accounts we offer integration via customer KMS for storage encryption (we can provide architecture note). I attached the SOC2 report and our KMS integration note. If BYOK is a hard requirement for the POC, we should discuss Private deployment pricing in parallel; otherwise the interim approach is acceptable for a de-identified POC.

3) MAP update: I've converted the attached MAP to a mutual-action table with owners and dates (see redwood_map_v1.pdf). Proposed go/no-go decision meeting: 2025-10-28. If we hit that, order form expansion/renewal can be executed by 2025-11-05.

Next actions:
- Samantha / Mark: confirm acceptance of the sequencing (MSA+DPA parallel, POC order form time-boxed) and whether NovaHealth will circulate redlines by 2025-10-07.
- Ava / Laura: we'll prepare a DocuSign bundle for MSA+DPA + POC order form and a slim appendix for the de-identified dataset allowance.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachment stubs: redwood_map_v1.pdf (MAP), redwood_msa_redlines_v1.docx (MSA redlines), SOC2-Type2-2024.pdf (security evidence)
